title: adiantum tenerum var. littorale
intro: Adiantum tenerum var. littorale, commonly known as New Zealand maidenhair fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Adiantum tenerum var. littorale include its use as a diuretic, an anti-inflammatory, and an antispasmodic, which can help to relieve symptoms of urinary tract issues, arthritis, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
